name.en: Crowd Crush During Evacuations or Public Events
name.fil: Crowd Crush During Evacuations or Public Events (Siksikan o Stampede)

lessons.en: Know two exits, stay near the edges, and leave early when a crowd feels too tight.
lessons.fil: Alamin ang dalawang exit, manatili sa gilid, at umalis nang maaga kapag masyado nang masikip.

lessons.en: If caught, keep your arms in front of your chest and move with the flow toward the sides.
lessons.fil: Kapag naipit, itaas ang braso sa harap ng dibdib at sumabay sa agos papunta sa gilid.

lessons.en: During evacuations: don't push, don't talk, don't run, don't return.
lessons.fil: Tuwing evacuation: huwag magtulakan, huwag magdaldalan, huwag tumakbo, huwag bumalik.

choices.en: So many people are packed together that they cannot move freely and the pressure becomes dangerous
choices.fil: Sobrang siksikan ng tao kaya hindi na sila makagalaw at nagiging delikado ang pressure
Maayos na nakapila ang mga tao

choices.en: People walk slowly in a park
choices.fil: Mabagal na naglalakad ang mga tao sa park

explain.en: Crushes come from too many people in too little space, not usually from carelessness.
explain.fil: Ang crush ay dahil sa sobrang dami ng tao sa maliit na espasyo, hindi kadalasan dahil sa kapabayaan.

question.en: What do you call a narrow place, like a doorway or stairway, where crowds slow down and pile up?
question.fil: Ano ang tawag sa makitid na lugar, tulad ng pinto o hagdan, kung saan bumabagal at nagsisiksikan ang mga tao?

explain.en: Bottlenecks concentrate people, so pass through them calmly or avoid them.
explain.fil: Dito nagkukumpol ang mga tao, kaya dumaan nang mahinahon o iwasan ito.

question.en: Stopping to pick up something you dropped in a moving crowd is safe.
question.fil: Ligtas huminto para pulutin ang nahulog mong gamit sa gumagalaw na siksikan.

explain.en: Bending down can make you fall or be pushed. Leave the item.
explain.fil: Kapag yumuko ka, puwede kang matumba o maitulak. Iwan na ang gamit.

question.en: If caught in a dense crowd, keep your arms up in front of your ____ to protect your breathing space.
question.fil: Kapag naipit sa siksikan, itaas ang braso sa harap ng iyong ____ para maprotektahan ang espasyo para makahinga.

explain.en: Arms in front of the chest keep room to breathe under pressure.
explain.fil: Ang braso sa harap ng dibdib ay nagbibigay ng espasyo para makahinga kahit may pressure.

question.en: Match each crowd safety measure with what it does.
question.fil: Itugma ang bawat crowd safety measure sa ginagawa nito.

pairs.en: Lets in only as many people as the space can hold
pairs.fil: Pinapapasok lang ang kayang laman ng lugar

pairs.en: Separate lanes for going in and coming out
pairs.fil: Magkahiwalay na daan papasok at palabas

pairs.en: Staff who guide people and watch the crowd
pairs.fil: Staff na gumagabay sa tao at nagbabantay sa siksikan
Mga daan palabas sa iba't ibang gilid

explain.en: Organizers use these measures to prevent most crowd crushes.
explain.fil: Ginagamit ng organizers ang mga ito para maiwasan ang karamihan ng crowd crush.

question.en: Name 3 warning signs that a crowd is becoming dangerous.
question.fil: Magbigay ng 3 babala na nagiging delikado na ang siksikan.

show.en: you cannot move freely, you are pressed on all sides, the crowd sways in waves, people shout for help, people fall, exits are blocked
show.fil: hindi ka na makagalaw nang malaya, naiipit ka sa lahat ng gilid, umuuga ang tao na parang alon, may sumisigaw ng tulong, may natutumba, nakaharang ang mga exit

explain.en: Noticing early gives you time to move to the edges or leave.
explain.fil: Kapag napansin mo agad, may oras ka pang lumipat sa gilid o umalis.

question.en: At a free concert, the crowd near the stage gets tighter and your little brother starts crying. What should you do?
question.fil: Sa isang free concert, lalong sumisikip malapit sa stage at nagsimulang umiyak ang nakababata mong kapatid. Ano ang dapat mong gawin?

choices.en: Push forward to get to the stage
Hold his hand, keep him in front of you, and move toward the edges and an exit
choices.fil: Hawakan ang kamay niya, ilagay siya sa harap mo, at lumipat papunta sa gilid at sa exit

choices.en: Lift him on your shoulders and stay
choices.fil: Pasanin siya sa balikat at manatili

explain.en: Children feel crowd pressure sooner. Leaving early is the safest choice.
explain.fil: Mas maagang nararamdaman ng mga bata ang pressure ng siksikan. Pinakaligtas ang maagang pag-alis.

question.en: Arrange the steps of a calm school evacuation.
question.fil: Ayusin ang mga hakbang ng mahinahong school evacuation.

steps.en: Walk calmly using your class's assigned exit and stairway
steps.fil: Maglakad nang mahinahon gamit ang nakatalagang exit at hagdan ng klase ninyo

steps.en: Keep to the four don'ts: no pushing, talking, running, or returning
steps.fil: Sundin ang apat na huwag: huwag magtulakan, magdaldalan, tumakbo, o bumalik

steps.en: Wait at the assembly area for the head count
steps.fil: Maghintay sa assembly area para sa head count

explain.en: Assigned exits spread classes out, and calm walking prevents falls.
explain.fil: Napaghihiwalay ng nakatalagang exit ang mga klase, at naiiwasan ang pagkatumba kapag mahinahong naglalakad.

scene.en: In a mall, someone shouts that something dangerous is happening, and people start running toward one exit.
scene.fil: Sa isang mall, may sumigaw na may delikadong nangyayari, at nagsimulang magtakbuhan ang mga tao papunta sa iisang exit.

choices.en: Stay calm, move to the side or into a store, and listen for mall security announcements
choices.fil: Manatiling kalmado, tumabi o pumasok sa isang tindahan, at pakinggan ang announcement ng mall security
Sumigaw nang mas malakas para bigyang-babala ang iba

explain.en: Rumors can cause dangerous rushes even when there is no real threat.
explain.fil: Kayang magdulot ng delikadong takbuhan ang tsismis kahit wala namang totoong banta.
